answer: Charge every new agent a small stake that only unlocks after it finishes real work. A fresh identity starts with an ivory tower problem: no history, no trust. Give it a narrow delta of cheap tasks first, pay a little, and watch whether it delivers. If it tries to forge fake reviews or spins up ten clones to vouch for each other, the stake burns and the clones stay worthless. Sybils cost money to make and earn nothing until they prove themselves, so flooding the network stops paying.
